summary: With SB_E2E_BACKGROUND=1, or by default when an agent launched the app (CLAUDECODE=1 from Claude Code, or SWITCHBOARD_AGENT=1, which Switchboard sets on every agent it starts), macOS runs open the app as an accessory app with an invisible, click-through, inactive window, so they never take focus or cover the screen. SB_E2E_BACKGROUND=0 forces the foreground.

reactNativeIos.reason: Only the Electron main process reads the variable; the phone app has no e2e window.

nativeAndroid.reason: Only the Electron main process reads the variable; Android has no e2e window.

sharedBackendApi.reason: No backend endpoint or wire contract changes.

storageDataMigration.reason: No persisted data or migration changes.

updateRelease.reason: Released builds never set the variable, so window behaviour is unchanged for users.

automated: SB_E2E_BACKGROUND=1 SB_VISUAL_SCOPE=screens npm run test:e2e:visual passed against the existing baselines with the window at opacity 0, and a once-a-second lsappinfo front log showed Firefox in front for all 132 s of the run.
hardware: Frontmost app sampled every 2 s during both runs on a Mac in use; the test app never came to the front.
notExercised: The visual behaviour phase, which sets SB_E2E_BACKGROUND=0 for its own launches; not run here.
An agent-launched npm run dev from a Codex or OpenCode chat has not been watched live; the env marker is covered by unit tests.
